name: What is the typical process for wainscoting installation with Maine Results, Inc.?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for wainscoting installation with Maine Results, Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our wainscoting installation process begins with an initial consultation and on-site measurement to discuss your design preferences and assess the room. Following this, we provide a detailed quote. Once approved, our team carefully prepares the walls, which may involve minor repairs or baseboard removal. We then precisely cut and fit the chosen wainscoting panels and trim, securing them to the walls. The process concludes with caulking, sanding, and a final cleanup, preparing the wainscoting for painting or finishing. This structured approach, a first-party insight into our service, ensures a high-quality finish and minimizes disruption to your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our wainscoting installation includes consultation, on-site measurement, quoting, wall preparation, precise cutting and fitting of panels, and final cleanup, preparing for finishing.
